./docs/contributing/commands.md:167:Real commands do the same: `clever drain check` exposes `--app` and reads `appIdOrName`, which tells that the value is not resolved yet (`src/commands/drain/drain.check.command.js`). Only `name` is shown to the user, in `--help` and in the generated docs.
ls: cannot access 'node_modules': No such file or directory

I haven't written anything yet, because I can't find the API endpoint that `drain check` should call.

- **What the repo has:** `src/clever-client/drains.js` only covers list, create, get, delete, enable and disable. Nothing in the repo, docs or ADRs mentions a check or test route for drains. `node_modules` isn't installed, so I couldn't look in `@clevercloud/client` either.
- **A stale reference:** `docs/contributing/commands.md:167` says `src/commands/drain/drain.check.command.js` exists, but that file isn't in the tree.
- **Why I'm not guessing:** `AGENTS.md` says endpoints missing from the client go in `src/clever-client/`. A made-up route could silently do the wrong thing against production, so I'd rather not invent one.

Questions:
1. What is the endpoint? I need the method and path, for example `POST /v4/drains/organisations/{ownerId}/resources/{resourceId}/drains/check`. I also need the request body (I'd reuse the `recipient` shape from `drain create`) and what the response looks like.
2. If there's an OpenAPI spec or a `clever-client.js` branch with it, point me to it and I'll read it myself.

Once I have that, my plan is:
- Add `checkDrain` to `src/clever-client/drains.js`.
- Add `drain.check.command.js` with `since: null`. It takes the same `<drain-type> <drain-url>` arguments and credential options as `drain create`, plus `--format json`. I'd move the shared recipient-building logic into `src/models/drain.js` so the two commands don't duplicate it.
- Register it in `global.commands.js`.
- Run `npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate`.
